oems.name: Samsung
steps: Go to Settings > Battery and device care > Battery.

oems.name: Xiaomi / MIUI / HyperOS
steps: Go to Settings > Apps > Manage apps > ScrollGuard.

oems.name: OnePlus / OxygenOS
steps: Go to Settings > Battery > Battery usage.

oems.name: Oppo / Realme / ColorOS
steps: Go to Settings > Battery > More battery settings > App battery management.
Select ScrollGuard and turn on 'Allow background activity' and 'Allow auto-startup'.

oems.name: Pixel / Stock Android
steps: Go to Settings > Apps > ScrollGuard > App battery usage.
